name: Demetrius
description: Son of Seleucus, who departed from Rome, took a city of the sea coast and reigned there, had Antiochus and Lysias slain, made Alcimus high priest and sent him with Bacchides against Israel, and later sent Nicanor against Judas

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
